ambc.note: ambcknox.org events list and fallfest.ambcknox.org/schedule/: 17th annual Fall Fest, Fri Nov 6 - Sat Nov 7 at Baker Creek Preserve and Urban Wilderness Gateway Park, free. Friday: campground 5, beer garden and food trucks 5:30, Knoxville Utility Band 5:30, Friday Night Lights on the pump track and jump line 6:30, Best Day Ever film 6:45, Adventure Slideshows (PechaKucha) 8, last call 9:30, after party at Climbing Roots 10. Saturday: coffee and vendors 8:30, Joy Ride and aMTB demos 9:30, social, advanced and vintage rides 10, beer gardens 11, Mal Nombre noon, South Loop ride noon, bike parade 12:30, women's power hour and kids rides 1, Whip Off at Devil's Racetrack 3 (sign up by 2:30), strider race 4:45, Mercy Lights 5, Butcherbird 6, Best Line Invitational on the lit jump line 7, Megaweed 8:15, silent auction closes 8:30, bike raffle 9, New Speedway Honkers 9:30, silent disco 10:30. Free parking at Baker Creek Bottoms, South Doyle Middle (after 5 Friday) and the Gateway Park lot under Sevierville Pike; free camping. @ambcknox posts (Oct 22-31) match. Bear Wheels Nov 14 is in Carthage; Nov 23 meeting at SouthSide, Dec 12 Tour de Lights (leads).
